name: Lena Schmidt
title: Mid-level Technical Writer
summary: A dedicated and detail-oriented Mid-level Technical Writer with several years of experience creating clear, concise, and comprehensive documentation for software products and APIs. Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into user-friendly content, improving user experience and product adoption. Skilled in various documentation tools and methodologies, committed to delivering high-quality technical assets.

bullets: Authored and maintained comprehensive API documentation for 5+ microservices using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications, reducing support inquiries by 15%.
Developed and implemented a new documentation review process, improving content accuracy by 20% and reducing time-to-publish by 10 days.
Created user manuals and installation guides for B2B SaaS products, leading to a 25% increase in successful first-time user setups.
Utilized Python scripts to automate routine tasks, such as generating release notes from Jira tickets, saving approximately 4 hours per release cycle.
Contributed to the development of online help systems and knowledge base articles for enterprise software solutions, assisting over 10,000 users monthly.
Collaborated with software developers and product managers to gather information and ensure technical accuracy, resulting in a 98% satisfaction rate for documentation quality.
Managed content updates for 3 product lines across multiple versions, ensuring all documentation was up-to-date with product features.
Assisted senior technical writers in creating and editing documentation for data analytics platforms.
Conducted user testing on preliminary documentation drafts to gather feedback and identify areas for improvement.
Organized and cataloged existing documentation assets, improving accessibility by 30% for the writing team.
